simple.meaning: אֲדֻמִּים (ʼĂdummîym) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Joshua, beginning at Joshua 15:7. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship.
